Where the seven days went

Three days were matching freight receipts to invoices by hand. Two were chasing the four carriers whose statements arrive as scanned paper. The last two were the review itself.

Ledgerline matches receipts as they land and reads the scanned statements the same afternoon, so the review starts on the first of the month.

See your own close run on your own ledger

Bring one month of invoices. The walkthrough runs on your data, takes forty minutes, and ends with the day count you would have had.
